description: Adds or corrects fields on an existing draft (patch semantics: only provided fields are changed; array fields are replaced whole). Requires a verificationToken for the email that created the draft. Fails once the draft has been submitted.

alternativeCompanyNames.description: Fallback company names in priority order

shareAmount.description: Number of shares allocated to this founder

jurisdiction.description: Target jurisdiction, e.g. "BVI", "CAYMAN", "PANAMA" — free text is accepted

notes.description: Anything else relevant: existing structures, PEP status, special requests

urgency.description: Timeline constraints, e.g. "needed before token launch July 1"

verificationToken.description: Token from verify_email_otp for the email that created the draft
